description: Attribute and `has` access on an entity literal Foo::"id" that names the principal / action / resource. The literal resolves through the matching per-slot attribute array, just like the bare keyword, so reference Cedar (which resolves it via the entity store) and nxe-cedar agree. A literal that names no request entity has no attribute store, so attribute / has access errors and the policy is not applicable (default deny); that decision still matches the oracle, whose entity store also lacks the literal.

tests.name: principal_literal_attr_matches
tests.description: principal literal attribute resolves through principal_attrs

tests.name: principal_literal_attr_mismatch_denies
tests.description: principal literal attribute that differs denies

tests.name: resource_literal_attr_matches
tests.description: resource literal attribute resolves through resource_attrs

tests.name: action_literal_attr_matches
tests.description: action literal long attribute resolves through action_attrs

tests.name: principal_literal_matches_request_var_attr
tests.description: literal attribute equals the same attribute read via the keyword
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { User::"alice".role == principal.role };

tests.name: principal_literal_has_present
tests.description: has on principal literal is true when the attribute exists
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { User::"alice" has role };

tests.name: principal_literal_has_absent_denies
tests.description: has on principal literal is false when the attribute is absent
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { User::"alice" has missing };

tests.name: if_has_then_attr_else_default
tests.description: issue example: has-guarded attribute access on a principal literal
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { (if (User::"alice" has tag) then (User::"alice".z) else "x") like "" };

tests.name: principal_literal_in_parent_resolves
tests.description: in on a principal literal resolves parents through principal_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { User::"alice" in Group::"admins" };

tests.name: non_request_literal_in_parent_denies
tests.description: in on a literal that names no request entity consults no parents (matches reflexively only)
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { Other::"x" in Group::"admins" };

tests.name: non_request_literal_attr_denies
tests.description: attribute access on a literal that names no request entity errors (not applicable)

tests.name: non_request_literal_attr_negated_still_denies
tests.description: an erroring attribute access is not rescued by negation (the error propagates)
